threshold_gnss_stddev_yaw_deg_max.description: If GNSS yaw standard deviation values are larger than this, trust only NDT

threshold_gnss_stddev_z_max.description: If GNSS position Z standard deviation values are larger than this, trust only NDT

threshold_gnss_stddev_xy_bound_lower.description: If GNSS position XY standard deviation values are lower than this, trust only GNSS

threshold_gnss_stddev_xy_bound_upper.description: If GNSS position XY standard deviation values are higher than this, trust only NDT

ndt_std_dev_bound_lower.description: Lower bound value for standard deviation of NDT positions (x, y, z) when used with GNSS

ndt_std_dev_bound_upper.description: Upper bound value for standard deviation of NDT positions (x, y, z) when used with GNSS

gnss_pose_timeout_sec.description: If GNSS data is not received for this duration, trust only NDT

switch_to_ndt_count_threshold.description: Number of consecutive degraded GNSS poses required before switching toward NDT

switch_to_gnss_count_threshold.description: Number of consecutive recovered GNSS poses required before switching toward GNSS

gnss_ndt_position_difference_threshold.description: Maximum GNSS/NDT horizontal position difference allowed when recovering GNSS

gnss_ndt_yaw_difference_threshold_deg.description: Maximum GNSS/NDT yaw difference allowed when recovering GNSS

use_ndt_orientation_with_gnss_position.description: Experimental mode: publish GNSS position with NDT orientation while GNSS is usable
